title: The Attribution Blind Spot: Detecting When Language Models Rely on Memory Rather Than Retrieved Context
authors: Zhe Yu; Wenpeng Xing; Yunzhao Wei; Bo Yang; Chen Ye; Gaolei Li; Meng Han
why_relevant: Studies whether RAG generations are governed by retrieved context vs parametric memory, introducing a diagnostic (CRM) for attribution—directly relevant to knowledge conflict and trust/calibration in RAG.
why_not_or_caveat: Focuses on detecting memory-vs-context reliance rather than mitigating noise/adversaries; diagnostic substrate rather than full control mechanism.
